description: Provenance for external/ore/examples/ -- a sync of the ORE Engine fork's own Examples/ directory (minus its pytest test-harness files, see external/ore/tools/update_ore_samples.sh's header comment for the exclude list), with exactly 3 known upstream-bug hand-patches reapplied automatically after every sync (KNOWN_PATCH_FILES in that same script -- upstream ships a genuinely wrong FX/RATE key order in these files; see the script's header comment and doc/agile/product_backlog/deferred/document_ore_vendor_hand_patches.org for why). No other manual edits anywhere in this tree.
tree_sha256_method: sha256 of the sorted 'sha256sum  relative/path' lines for every vendored file (manifest.json/README.md/methodology.txt themselves excluded) -- reproducible by re-running this script against the same engine_commit and diffing the regenerated manifest.json's own tree_sha256.
